create_scheduler_flow_match_euler: create a FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler instance with configurable timesteps, shift, and sigma schedule options
set_scheduler_timesteps: set discrete inference timesteps for the scheduler with optional sigmas, mu, or custom timesteps array
run_scheduler_step: run one denoising step of the Euler scheduler given model output, timestep, and current sample
scale_scheduler_noise: apply flow-matching noise scaling to a sample at a given timestep using sigma interpolation
add_scheduler_noise: add noise to a clean latent tensor at a specified timestep using sigma-weighted interpolation
